CustomField.description: Per-day first-seen cursors accumulated so far, as JSON of day to {pk, rk}. Carried alongside Partial Tally for the same reason: the walk spans many transactions and a day first seen in job 5 must still be publishable when job 108 finishes. Merged first-wins, never overwritten, because jobs walk the table in order so the earliest sighting is the lowest cursor. One entry per day on which archiving ran, not one per record.
CustomField.label: Partial Day Cursors
